Septal defects occur in 40-60%, sensorineural loss in 2/4 and congenital hypothyroidism in 1/3; airway and ocular findings omitted under cap; estimates use small subsets.

Intestinal fructose malabsorption defines the condition; the definition distinguishes it from hereditary systemic fructose metabolism disease.
